column6: flag word: only its low 16 bits are used: & 0x200 sets the +0x78 field to 0x80e2 (and _gleCreateTextureObject allocates no face records), (& 0xf) selects the texture kind (0 = 6 faces, 2 = clamp-to-edge/linear defaults, 1/3/4 other defaults, tested by the switch), & 0x2000 (renderbuffer, passed as 0x2000 by the renderbuffer creation) takes the clamp-to-edge path; callers pass 2 for the default textures

number of faces: _gleCreateTextureObject computes 0 when (flags & 0x200), else 6 when (flags & 0xf) == 0, else 1 and allocates faceCount*0x168+0x944 bytes; here it bounds the per-face loop (stride 0x168 = 15 level records of 0x18 bytes)
the texture object state block being reset to defaults (the caller passes allocation+0x10, the field after the 0x10-byte header); wrap/filter/format defaults are written at fixed offsets
0x812f (GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE) for kind 2 (rectangle), else 0x2901 (GL_REPEAT): stored to the three wrap fields (+0x34/+0x36/+0x38)
0x2601 (GL_LINEAR) for kind 2 (rectangle), else 0x2702 (GL_NEAREST_MIPMAP_LINEAR): stored to the min filter field (+0x3a)
cursor over the 15 per-level records (0x18 bytes each, +0xc4 of the face block) of the current face: fields cleared, format reset to 0x1908 (GL_RGBA) / 0x1401 (GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE)
